main_text.p: Ancyranus, lib. 2. cap. 14. Severianus Gabalonensis in 1. ad Corinthios, lib. 5. cap. 5. Apollinaris in Numeros, lib. 4. c. 14. Leontius in Matthæum, lib. 4. cap. 10. Eustratius Constantinopolitanus de operatione animæ, lib. 4. c. 14. Damascenus de jejuniis, & de communione corporis, lib. 5. cap. 8. & 18. lib. 4. cap. 1. Theodorus Antiochenus, ille scil. qui Mopsuestenam Ecclesiam rexit, lib. 2. cap. 20. lib. 4. cap. 8. & lib. 5. cap. 6. Theophanes in Symphonia Veteris & Novi Testamenti, lib. 2. cap. 28. & lib. 4. c. 13. Constantinus ἐκ τῶν σχολαστικῶν, lib. 1. cap. 28. Photii Lexicon, quæstiones ad Amphilochium, Commentarii in Epistolas, lib. 3. c. 11. & 12. lib. 5. cap. 18. lib. 2. cap. 13. lib. 4. c. 12. Nilus in Lucam, lib. 5. cap. 6. Pamphili Canones, lib. 1. c. 25. Quæ excerpsit & observavit Blondellus in Pseudo-Isidoro & Turriano vapulante in prolegom. cap. 1. pag. 7. quibus subjungit sequens hoc elogium, & specimina errorum. Plurimæ sane, inquit, lectionis, sed frontis perfrictissimæ, judiciique tenuissimi, homo asper & improbus ira, gloriæ animal, Pyrgopolinices alter, qui Hincmarum Rhemensis Ecclesiæ in Gallia Belgica Præsulem, lib. 1. c. 15. & lib. 3. c. 3. Germanicæ nationis Episcopum fuisse scribit; qui lib. 2. c. 20. &c. infamem 236. De Turriano elogia, & ejus errores historici.

page.notes: Marginal note at right reads "236. De Turriano elogia, & ejus errores historici." Catchword "famem" at foot right. Some lines are faint or show-through; the Greek phrase is transcribed as read and may be imperfect. The printed page number is "265" with a long-s style "s" rendered as 5 in the scan.
